title: Non-smoothable Calabi-Yau threefolds from reflexive polytopes
summary: We construct projective Calabi-Yau threefolds with isolated Gorenstein canonical singularities that admit no smoothing, as anticanonical hypersurfaces in Gorenstein Fano toric fourfolds. One example has a unique singularity, the anticanonical cone over the first Hirzebruch surface. Another has a unique singularity whose reduced miniversal base is a smooth curve but whose deformations are all singular.
